facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs' written reply says the Department has stabilised and improved its Online Verification Service (OVS) and implemented facial biometric verification.

ZAF.note: Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Mentions support for rural communities only as a stated benefit of a proposed framework.
Draft Digital Identity Regulations are a draft rule under the 1997 Act; the reply does not say the Act provides for a digital identity.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the platform.
No register keyed on the ID number named; a SARS partnership on infrastructure is not that.

facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs says the Department is expanding Smart ID and passport services through banks, under agreements signed with major banks.

The Minister of Home Affairs says the Department is expanding API-based integration for real-time identity verification with public and private sector institutions, and has signed agreements with major banks.
The Minister of Home Affairs says the Department is modernising the population register and strengthening biometric and verification capabilities.
